goal: Add a cart module in src/ that stores money as integer cents and rejects negative quantities, following the repository's conventions, with node:test coverage including a rounding trap
required_behavior: The new code follows the conventions in the repository's config files
A cart module exists in src/
The cart stores money as integer cents
node:test cases cover the cart, including a 0.1 + 0.2 style rounding trap

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The cart module follows the conventions set by the repository's config files (eslint.config.js, package.json)
A cart module exists at src/cart.js
The cart stores and totals money as integer cents, never as fractional amounts
Adding an item with a negative quantity is rejected
node:test cases cover the cart module
One test is a rounding trap: amounts that would total 0.30000000000000004 in floating point total exactly 30 cents in the cart
Monetary values are stored as 16-bit integers
A negative quantity returns the exact message 'Invalid input'

verification_plan: Check src/cart.js against the repository's lint and package conventions
Add items and check every stored amount and total is an integer number of cents
Add an item with a negative quantity and check it is rejected
Run the node:test suite, including the rounding-trap case

requirements.quote: Read this repo’s config files and treat them as my developer conventions,
then add a cart module in src/

proposed_defaults.text: Use 16-bit integers for storing monetary values
proposed_defaults.reason: The request does not say how large amounts can be

proposed_defaults.text: Return 'Invalid input' error message for negative values
proposed_defaults.reason: The request does not name the error
